centerAria: Email body with highlighted personal information
noExampleSelected: Select an example on the left.
waitingExtract: Run extraction to highlight detected personal information.
deterministicWaitingExtract: Run deterministic scan to highlight pattern-matched spans (keyword-gated).
cachedDeterministicExtractStatus: Showing cached deterministic results. Run deterministic again to refresh.
agentExtractCompleteStatus: Agent highlights updated. Run extraction again to refresh.
deterministicExtractCompleteStatus: Deterministic highlights updated. Run deterministic again to refresh.
cachedExtractStatus: Showing cached agent results from local_cache. Run extraction again to refresh.
missingApiKeyHint: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY in genai/.env (recommended), OPENAI_API_KEY_PARAM_NAME plus REGION for SSM, or OPENAI_API_KEY_S3_URI plus REGION — see toolkit README.
clearAgentPaneAria: Clear cached agent extraction for the selected example
clearDeterministicPaneAria: Clear cached deterministic scan for the selected example
matchBadgeBothTitle: Also found by the other method (overlapping span and type).
matchBadgeExclusiveTitle: Found only by this method (no overlapping match in the other list).
statusBothPanesReady: Agent and deterministic lists are populated. Markers show agreement (both) vs one method only.
statusAgentOnlyReady: Agent results shown; run deterministic to compare.
statusDeterministicOnlyReady: Deterministic results shown; run extraction to compare.
statusBothPanesEmpty: Run extraction and/or deterministic scan to populate the side panes.
usageDetailsAria: Usage and timing for the last extraction
